title: Only 11% Can Pass This Firefighter Entrance Exam
summary: Explore Station Briefing 🚒, Smoke & Signals 🔥, Tools & Mechanics 🧰, Incident Ground ⚠️, Final Alarm 🚨 across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Read the clues. Make the connections.
Put your thinking to the test.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Station Briefing 🚒, Smoke & Signals 🔥, Tools & Mechanics 🧰, Incident Ground ⚠️, Final Alarm 🚨. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an accredited firefighter entrance exam, employment assessment, fitness test, qualification, operational training course or source of emergency advice. Fire-service procedures vary worldwide; always follow local emergency services and qualified professional guidance.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.

firefighter-s1q1.question: Heat and fuel are present. Which third element is needed to complete the fire triangle?

answers.a2: Oxygen
answers.a3: Smoke
answers.a4: Ash

firefighter-s1q2.question: A sparking electrical panel stands beside a pool of water. What is the safest first response?

answers.a1: Step through the water to switch it off
answers.a2: Pour more water over the panel
answers.a3: Move the panel by its outer case
answers.a4: Keep people clear and alert qualified responders

visual.ariaLabel: Six sealed packs containing four masks each

firefighter-s1q3.question: How many masks are stored in total?

firefighter-s1q4.question: Which update gives the clearest incident handover?

answers.a2: There are several details, but the situation is unclear
answers.a3: Smoke is at the east entrance; that route is blocked; people are moving west
answers.a4: I know what caused everything, so no observations are needed

firefighter-s1q5.question: A pry bar is used as a lever. What usually happens when the grip moves farther from the pivot?

answers.a2: The pivot stops working
answers.a3: Less force is needed for the same turning effect
answers.a4: The load becomes weightless

firefighter-s1q6.question: Why do hot gases and smoke usually rise above cooler air?

answers.a1: Heating makes the gases less dense
answers.a2: Smoke is pulled upward by gravity
answers.a3: Cool air becomes lighter than hot air
answers.a4: Ash forces every gas toward the ceiling

firefighter-s2q1.question: One end of a metal rail becomes hot and the other end warms later. Which heat-transfer process is this?

answers.a2: Radiation
answers.a3: Conduction
answers.a4: Evaporation

visual.ariaLabel: At the north doorway, smoke was earlier light and steady but is now increasing rapidly

firefighter-s2q2.question: Which report best communicates the change without guessing at its cause?

answers.a1: Smoke at the north doorway has changed from light and steady to rapidly increasing
answers.a2: The exact burning material has been identified from the smoke
answers.a3: Nothing important has changed because smoke was already present
answers.a4: The fire will definitely remain in the same area

firefighter-s2q3.question: Gear A turns clockwise and directly meshes with Gear B. Which way does Gear B turn?

answers.a1: Clockwise at the same speed in every case
answers.a2: It does not move
answers.a3: Upward
answers.a4: Counterclockwise

firefighter-s2q4.question: A sealed cylinder is heating and hissing near a building. What is the safest response?

answers.a2: Keep people clear and alert qualified specialists
answers.a3: Cool it by touching the casing with wet cloths
answers.a4: Turn its valve until the hissing stops

firefighter-s2q5.question: Can smoke colour by itself reliably identify the exact material burning?

answers.a1: No; smoke appearance can be affected by several conditions
answers.a2: Yes; every material always produces one unique colour
answers.a3: Yes, but only when viewed from indoors
answers.a4: No, because all smoke is visually identical

visual.ariaLabel: Map scale one centimetre equals five metres and the route measures seven centimetres

firefighter-s2q6.question: What real distance does the route represent?

answers.a2: 30 metres
answers.a3: 35 metres
answers.a4: 40 metres

firefighter-s3q1.question: In an ideal fixed-pulley setup, what is the pulley's main advantage?

answers.a2: It removes friction from the rope
answers.a3: It doubles every pulling force
answers.a4: It changes the direction of the pull

visual.ariaLabel: A map scale of one centimetre to twelve point five metres and a route measuring four point eight centimetres

firefighter-s3q2.question: Using the scale shown, what real distance does the 4.8 cm route represent?

answers.a2: 60 metres
answers.a3: 65 metres
answers.a4: 70 metres

firefighter-s3q3.question: A damaged container is leaking and an unknown chemical smell is present. What is the safest first decision?

answers.a1: Move close enough to identify it by smell
answers.a2: Pick up the container and read its underside
answers.a3: Keep clear and request qualified hazardous-materials guidance
answers.a4: Dilute the leak with water

visual.ariaLabel: Inspect equipment, find a defect, complete a missing step, then report it

firefighter-s3q4.question: Which step best completes the safe equipment sequence?

answers.a2: Use it before the defect grows
answers.a3: Hide the damaged area
answers.a4: Return it without a label

firefighter-s3q5.question: Which order makes a concise incident handover easiest to follow?

answers.a2: Location, observed hazard, people affected, action taken
answers.a3: Action taken, unrelated history, opinion, location
answers.a4: Guess, conclusion, missing detail, location

firefighter-s3q6.question: A hot surface warms your face from several metres away without contact. Which heat-transfer process best explains this?

answers.a2: Conduction
answers.a3: Evaporation
answers.a4: Condensation

firefighter-s4q1.question: Bystanders are moving toward an unstable wall while a routine inventory is due. What takes priority?

answers.a1: Move people away from the hazard and report it
answers.a2: Finish the inventory before responding
answers.a3: Wait to see whether the wall moves
answers.a4: Ask the bystanders to complete the inventory

firefighter-s4q2.question: A strong gas smell and hissing cylinder are noticed beside a public path. What should happen first?

answers.a1: Move the cylinder away by hand
answers.a2: Turn the valve to test whether it closes
answers.a3: Keep people clear and alert qualified specialists
answers.a4: Cover the cylinder so nobody can see it

visual.ariaLabel: A route travels 30 metres east, 40 metres north and then 30 metres west

firefighter-s4q3.question: How far is the endpoint from the start in a straight line?

answers.a2: 40 metres
answers.a3: 60 metres
answers.a4: 70 metres

firefighter-s4q4.question: A layer of hot gas gathers high while cooler air remains lower. Which process best explains the movement?

answers.a2: Conduction
answers.a3: Compression
answers.a4: Convection

firefighter-s4q5.question: Which report gives the most useful combination of location, people and route conditions?

answers.a1: There could be an issue somewhere inside
answers.a2: The situation is serious, but the details can wait
answers.a3: A person may be missing, and one route looks unusual
answers.a4: One person was last seen in the rear office; east exit blocked; west route clear

firefighter-s4q7.question: A fire-damaged roof is sagging and fresh cracks are appearing. What is the safest interpretation?

answers.a2: The cracks show exactly where to stand
answers.a3: Collapse is possible, so keep clear and report the changing condition
answers.a4: The damage matters only after the incident

visual.ariaLabel: Hot smoke pulses outward at high level while air draws inward at low level

firefighter-s5q1.question: Which conclusion best combines the heat and airflow clues?

answers.a1: The lower air proves the room is safe
answers.a2: Active fire behaviour may be changing; keep clear and report both observations
answers.a3: The smoke identifies the exact material burning
answers.a4: Opening the space fully will always reduce the risk

firefighter-s5q2.question: A heavy equipment case must move up a short rise. A longer ramp is available and the route can be secured. Which plan best applies the mechanical principle safely?

answers.a1: Use the longer stable ramp and keep its route clear
answers.a2: Lift from the shortest edge without checking the route
answers.a3: Use the steepest ramp because distance never matters
answers.a4: Place the case above the ramp before securing it

items: PEOPLE::One person last seen in north office
visual.ariaLabel: One person was last seen in the north office, the east route is blocked and the west route is clear

firefighter-s5q3.question: Which handover best combines the person and route information?

answers.a1: There may be someone inside, but the route is probably fine
answers.a2: The east side is blocked, so no other detail is needed
answers.a3: The north office should be checked whenever convenient
answers.a4: One person was last seen in the north office; east route blocked; west route clear

visual.ariaLabel: Clockwise Gear A drives Gear B, which drives Gear C

firefighter-s5q5.question: Gear A drives B, and B drives C. Which way does Gear C turn?

answers.a2: Counterclockwise, after one reversal
answers.a3: It cannot turn because three gears are used
answers.a4: Upward because Gear A is first

visual.ariaLabel: Four crews need three lamps each, two spare lamps are required and two lamps have already been issued

firefighter-s5q6.question: How many more lamps must be drawn so every crew is equipped and two spares remain?

visual.ariaLabel: Smoke is thickening in the west corridor, two people are unaccounted for, the east exit is clear and a routine equipment count is due

firefighter-s5q8.question: What is the best first action and report?

answers.a1: Finish the count before reporting the smoke
answers.a2: Direct people east; report west smoke and two missing people; defer the count
answers.a3: Use the west corridor because it is shortest
answers.a4: Report only the equipment count
